propositions: A ticket directory containing no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated ticket plan reviews
Plan reviews fail with reason=reducer-error and reference pointing to an orphan event-less directory that is not referenced by any ticket and not visible to git
Event-less directories persist silently until manually removed, are invisible to git status, and block entire epic plan reviews from reaching LLM verdict
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the snapshot
The ticket writer creates the directory before writing its first event, which can leave orphans after process death during the staging-to-rename window
Reader-side tolerance is the only fix that repairs existing broken clones since git cannot track or pull empty directories
